title: 1900 Prairie's brick stable on the alley
items: The alley building behind 1900 Prairie Avenue, the Elbridge G. Keith house, is no longer a rough draft. It now stands as a two-storey brick stable, 15.4 m along the alley and 9.2 m deep, drawn from the 1911 fire-insurance map. The rough draft had it at one storey; the map says two.

A paired window sits where the map marks one, beside two carriage doors and a hay-loft hatch. A fire wall stands at the north end, where the map marks one, and a paved walk runs from the yard door to the house's back porch.
The doors, roof pitch and most windows are reconstructed, and they are listed on the building's card.
